proposed_steps: Freeze a complete identity frame retaining every source occurrence keyed by archive/member/line/record hash, plus page ID and revision. A unique page-ID constraint cannot inventory this archive faithfully.

Before any canonical choice, enumerate every occurrence of each repeated page ID in the complete frame. Preserve old and new original records and every original license statement; do not assume this two-record view covers all versions.

Review a deterministic current-revision policy only after frame completion. Highest revision ID is a possible future candidate, not a selection made here; ties with divergent original content require explicit holds/reconciliation rather than arbitrary source order.

Keep revision/history/redirect aliases in the same ancestry family. This explicit old-parent/new-parent capitalization move is evidence for a book-root alias relation, not a reason to lowercase all unrelated book titles.
Count identical retained text once in eventual distinct-content accounting while preserving both source occurrences and provenance. No current usable count changes before admission.

Reconcile CC BY-SA3.0 vs4.0 metadata using exact source/project/snapshot evidence. The newer metadata does not automatically relicense the old captured record; do not silently overwrite either license.
Freeze any resolved candidate population and family graph before probability sampling, split assignment or token counts. Continue all semantic/factual/rights/language/protected-content checks.
